description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The task involved restoring the `ChatHistory` feature with its `project` property inside `KanbanContainer.vue`.
2. A `showHistory` toggle was re-added to control visibility of the `ChatHistoryVue` component.
3. The `ChatHistoryVue` component receives `:projects="[project, ...$projects.childProjects]"` to maintain proper project context.

5. `KanbanContainer` listens to `@toggle-history` from `KanbanList` to flip the `showHistory` state and switch between the board list and chat history views.

messages.content: We must have multiple Kanban component instances with their own projects. Now they depend on activeProject, selected board,... change it so Kanban uses $props.params.params.project_id as the project id to work with

Looking at the code, I need to modify the Kanban component to work with a project passed via props instead of relying on `activeProject`, `activeBoard`, etc. from the global store. ```vue client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue ``` ### Key changes made: 1. **`props`** — Added `params` prop (`{ project_id, ... }`) so each Kanban instance knows which project to work with. 2. **`project` computed** — Resolves the project from `params.project_id` via `allProjectsById`, falling back to `activeProject` if not provided. 3. **`localKanban` + `localActiveBoard`** — Replaced global `$projects.kanban` and `$projects.activeBoard` with per-instance reactive data, so multiple Kanban instances don't interfere with each other. 4. **`loadKanban` / `saveKanban`** — Uses `project.$api` (the project's own API instance) instead of the global store API, so each instance loads/saves its own project's kanban data. 5. **`setActiveBoard`** — Now sets `localActiveBoard` instead of calling `$projects.setActiveBoard()`. 6. **`chats` computed** — Filters chats by `project.project_id` so only that project's chats are shown. 7. **`watch['params.project_id']`** — Triggers `projectChanged()` when the prop changes, reloading the correct project's kanban.
Well we need to do the same with KanbanContainer and propagate to other components so move the params stuff to KanbanContainer and pass a "project" prop to Kanban component and KanbanList

Looking at the comments, I need to: 1. Move `params` handling to `KanbanContainer` 2. Pass a `project` prop to `Kanban` and `KanbanList` 3.
